message: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY shares one query() call with 1 other statement, so PostgreSQL runs them in one implicit transaction and rejects it.
why: PostgreSQL cannot run this statement inside a transaction block. A query() string with several statements also runs as one implicit transaction.
safeAlternative: Run the statement on its own, in its own query() call, in a migration that runs outside a transaction. With TypeORM: set transaction = false on the migration and migrationsTransactionMode: "each" in the DataSource (and in the typeorm.transactionMode config).
